changelog: VoxyWatch now ships an ADK-ready agentic sidecar as `voxywatch-agentic.service`.
The sidecar is installed and updated with every signed VoxyWatch release, but fresh installs keep it disabled until the operator enables it.
changelog_es: VoxyWatch now ships a versioned ADK-ready sidecar skeleton as `voxywatch-agentic.service`, installed under `/opt/voxywatch/agentic` and updated with every signe
The sidecar is loopback-only, disabled by default on new installs and preserved across updates if the operator had already enabled it.
